action: Opens on the finished Majin Vegeta face (M forehead mark, screaming open mouth, sharp brow).
Starts from a plain sphere at low DynaMesh resolution and cuts it with a multi-point straight-line planar stroke (label 'SLICE', Angle=31) along the side of the face.
tool: curve cut stroke labelled SLICE (shelf: TrimCurve, ClipCurve, SliceCurve, Knife); DynaMesh
why: Carve the face silhouette from a sphere with straight planar cuts
reader_equivalent: Line Project / Box Trim (Lasso Trim) in sculpt mode, or bisect with fill; then voxel remesh

action: Result is a faceted head block (flat front plane, flat side planes, flat chin/jaw planes); keeps cutting with another straight stroke (Angle=174) at even lower resolution.
why: Low resolution keeps planes clean and cheap while defining the head box
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh at large voxel size + Line Project/Box Trim cuts

action: Head now softened into a smooth shield face with a flat forehead band and narrow chin; draws two angled V lines as eye/brow placement marks.
tool: DynaMesh remesh + smooth; thin line brush for marks
why: Go blocky -> soft by remeshing up, then mark feature placement with lines before carving
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh at smaller voxel + Smooth; Draw Sharp for guide lines

action: Pulls the nose out as a pointed wedge, carves a large rounded-rectangle open mouth cavity and creased squinting eye slits, brows pushed down toward the nose.
tool: Move/Inflat for nose, brush strokes for mouth cavity, crease lines for eyes (inferred)
why: Expression blocked at low res while the mesh is still cheap to remesh
reader_equivalent: Grab/Snake Hook for nose, Draw (inverted)/Clay for mouth cavity, Crease for eyelids; voxel remesh

action: Profile check of the long pointed nose; then cuts sharp brow ridge edges and a Y-shaped crease between the brows, eye lid lines as crisp double grooves.
why: Anime anger: hard brow ridge planes meeting in a sharp V over the nose
reader_equivalent: Crease (sharp) + Pinch; Flatten for brow planes

action: Engraves the M mark on the forehead as a groove, cuts a sharp-edged eye socket outline with a planar lid shelf, and sculpts the open mouth with a lip rim and tongue mass.
why: Detail pass only after remeshing up to high resolution
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh fine (or Multires) + Crease/Draw Sharp; Clay Strips for tongue

action: Hair built as many separate faceted cone spikes (planar sides, sharp tips, low poly) packed into a crown, then the spikes are softened/merged into flowing pointed locks with flow grooves.
tool: separate low-res spike meshes (DynaMesh Resolucion 416, SDiv 1, 0.128 KP poly count) then smoothing/polish (inferred)
why: Super-Saiyan spikes read best as hard planar cones first, softened afterwards
reader_equivalent: Low-poly cone objects (Edit Mode) arranged, then Subdivision/voxel remesh + Smooth and Crease for lock lines

action: Front and 3-4 reviews of the finished face: rotates head, adds cheek/neck lines and rough marks around the eyes, shows the ear and neck tendons.
why: Check expression symmetry and silhouette from several angles
